total.name: order backlog
total.quote: The dollar amount of backlog believed to be firm was approximately $51.2 billion at December 31, 2025 and $30.0 billion at December 31, 2024.

input.note: The filing does not report "demand from data centers" as a quantified figure for order backlog growth. While passages E1, E2, E3, and E10 mention that data center demand is driving growth in Power Generation within Energy & Transportation, no specific dollar amounts are attributed to data centers. The filing only provides the total backlog figures and notes that the largest increase was in Power & Energy/Energy & Transportation segment, but does not break down the contribution of data center demand specifically.
